note: Testnet limits, read by script/DeployCreditStack.s.sol. The settlement token (mUSDC) has 18 decimals and a public mint, so these caps are generous and carry no real money. Mainnet limits live in robinhood_mainnet.limits.json.

credit.note: supplyCap is in TSLA base units (18 decimals): 1e24 = 1,000,000 TSLA. borrowCap is in mUSDC base units (18 decimals): 1e24 = 1,000,000 mUSDC. Staleness is 24 hours because the simulator and the manual feeder move prices at any hour.
